events.text: Class 50 locomotive construction begins as standard goods-train engine.

evidence.quote: built from 1939 as a standard locomotive

events.text: Romanian State Railway CFR produced 282 Class 50 copies, 1947 to 1959.

evidence.quote: CFR produced 282 copies of Class 50 locomotives between 1947 and 1959

events.text: Henschel rebuilds locomotive 50 1412 with Franco-Crosti boiler.

evidence.quote: Henschel rebuilt number 50 1412 in 1954 with such a boiler

events.text: Forty Romanian-built copies supplied to China.
30 engines fitted with Franco-Crosti preheaters, renumbered 50 4001-4031.

evidence.quote: In 1958 , 30 more engines were given Franco-Crosti smoke gas preheaters

events.text: 208 Class 50 locomotives rebuilt as 50.35 with new boiler, 1958 to 1962.

evidence.quote: Between 1958 and 1962 , 208 Class 50 locomotives were given such a boiler

events.text: Ten locomotives given boiler with smaller grate area as coal-saving trial.

evidence.quote: a boiler with smaller grate area in order to try to reduce the consumption of coal

events.text: Romanian-built copies became class DK5, numbered 241-280.
72 Class 50.35 locomotives converted to oil-firing, redesignated 50.50, 1966 to 1971.

evidence.quote: Between 1966 and 1971 , 72 Class 50.35 locomotives were converted to oil-firing

events.label: withdrawal
events.text: Franco-Crosti converted locomotives retired from service.
Deutsche Bundesbahn grouped locomotives into Classes 050, 051, 052, 053.

evidence.quote: The Deutsche Bundesbahn grouped the locomotives into Classes 050 , 051 , 052 and 053 from 1968

events.text: Locomotives given EDP operating numbers 50 0001 to 50 0072.

evidence.quote: From the introduction of EDP numbers in 1970 they were given operating numbers 50 0001 to 50 0072

events.label: withdrawal
events.text: Last Deutsche Bundesbahn locomotives retired from Duisburg-Wedau.

evidence.quote: The last DB locomotives were retired from Duisburg-Wedau in 1977

events.label: withdrawal
events.text: Class 50.40 locomotives taken out of traction service, used as heating engines.

evidence.quote: the locos were taken out of traction service by 1980

events.label: withdrawal
events.text: Class 50.50 locomotives suddenly withdrawn for political reasons.

evidence.quote: Their sudden withdrawal in 1981 was a political decision

events.label: withdrawal
events.text: Last Class 50 engines end active duties, together with Rekoloks.

evidence.quote: ones ended their active duties in 1987 together with the rebuilds

events.label: farewell
events.text: Last regular standard-gauge steam train, hauled by 50 3559, farewell service.

evidence.quote: headed an official farewell service on 29 October 1988
